Custom ERP vs off-the-shelf

Build it
or buy it?

Five questions to answer before you sign an ERP contract.

The short answer

Buy when your processes are standard and you need to go live in weeks.

Build when your workflow is your advantage, or when bending a package costs almost as much as building.

01

Is your process your advantage?

Unusual production flows, job-work, custom pricing or multi-stage quality checks are hard to force into a generic package.

02

Is your team keeping side spreadsheets?

If people work around the ERP to get their job done, you are paying twice: once for the licence, once in lost hours.

03

What do licences cost at twice your size?

Per-user pricing hurts once warehouse, shop-floor and field staff all need access. Compare over five years, not the first invoice.

04

Are customisations nearing build cost?

Heavily customised packages get expensive to upgrade, and some changes break every time the vendor ships a new version.

05

Can you go live one module at a time?

Most growing companies don't replace everything. Keep accounting where it is, build the part that hurts most, and sync the two.
